v4.6.1 — auto-sync slot keys to APEX server

🐛 FIXED
• Cloud bots no longer fail with "MUST ASSIGN API KEY IN TOOLS" right after you save slot keys. The Save slots button now automatically pushes the updated keys to the APEX server in the background, so cloud-uploaded bots (CRYPTO, custom bots, DAY after a key change, etc.) see them immediately — no separate sync click required.
• Save slots status line now reports both the local save AND the server sync result: "✓ CRYPTO, DAY saved locally AND synced to APEX server (4 keys encrypted on server) — cloud bots ready" on success, or a clear warning + retry hint if the sync fails.
• Falls back gracefully when not signed in: keys still save locally and the message explains cloud sync will happen after sign-in.
